resolution.note: krn adopt --init: git init on main, stack skeleton with real test, then adoption; fixture ends with green standards check

title: krn adopt --init prepares an empty or non-git directory: git init, test skeleton, tracker and standards
body:
Why: Fable plan 1114c missing item: 54 of 117 operator project dirs are not git.
Outcome: krn adopt --init on an empty or non-git directory runs git init, writes a minimal test skeleton and test command for the detected or chosen stack, the tracker and the standards files, then the normal adoption set.
Proof: fixture test on an empty temp directory ending with a green standards check; npm run fast PASS.
